question: True or false: judged by the US singles chart, Jimi Hendrix was a one-hit wonder?
answer: True. His only single in the US Top 40 was All Along the Watchtower, which peaked at number 20 in 1968. Hendrix lived on albums and on stage, which a singles chart does not count. Lists of one-hit wonders built from that chart sweep up acts that were giants by every other measure.
move: A label is only as good as the measure that produced it.
ask: Which label people put on me comes from a measure that misses what I do best?
trap: Thinking one-hit-wonder status measures a career, not one chart.
reference: Whitburn, The Billboard Book of Top 40 Hits, 9th edition, Billboard Books, 2010
